crossRefs.note: “Now I will show you the truth. Behold, three more kings will stand up in Persia; and the fourth will be far richer…
His sons will wage war, and will assemble a multitude of great forces, which will come on, and overflow, and pass…
A wrathful man stirs up contention, but one who is slow to anger appeases strife.
One who is greedy stirs up strife; but one who trusts in Yahweh will prosper.

translations.web: “He will stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south will wage war in battle with an exceedingly great and mighty army; but he won’t stand; for they will devise plans against him.
translations.bsb: And with a large army he will stir up his power and his courage against the king of the South, who will mobilize a very large and powerful army but will not withstand the plots devised against him.
translations.kjv: And he shall stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south shall be stirred up to battle with a very great and mighty army; but he shall not stand: for they shall forecast devices
translations.asv: And he shall stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south shall war in battle with an exceeding great and mighty army; but he shall not stand; for they shall devise devices against him.
